title: Import existing subscriptions
members_intro: Bring in existing members via CSV import. To enter them by hand, turn on onboarding mode at the bottom of the members page.
members_upload_disabled: CSV upload is disabled for this tenant (the "allow upload for data lists" setting).
members_manual_hint: Manual entry: turn on onboarding mode at the bottom of the members page. Member number and entry date then become editable in the grid.
intro: A tenant's existing members and subscriptions are imported in a fixed order: reference data first, then members, then subscriptions. Subscriptions reference the earlier data by human-readable natural keys (member number, variation name, …).

stage1.title: 1. Set up reference data
stage1.body: First create the data subscriptions reference: share types and their variations (incl. prices), delivery stations and days, and the payment cycles.

stage2.title: 2. Import members
stage2.body: Import members from your CSV. Each member gets a member number that the subscriptions reference.

stage3.title: 3. Import subscriptions
stage3.body: Upload the subscriptions. Each row references — by natural key — a member, a share-type variation, a payment cycle, and (optionally) a delivery station + day. Validate with a dry run first, then import.
stage3.drafts_notice: Imported subscriptions land as unconfirmed drafts (no deliveries, no billing). The office confirms them afterwards through the normal flow — that's where deliveries and charges are created under the usual capacity checks.

sub_help.size: Variation size (e.g. M) — with share type, active on the valid-from date.
sub_help.delivery_station: Delivery station short name (optional, with delivery day).
sub_help.valid_until: End date (Sunday), required — open-ended subscriptions are not allowed.
sub_help.subscription_number: Subscription number from the old system (optional, reference).

sepa_intro: Import existing SEPA direct-debit mandates from your old system. Each row resolves a member by member number and creates that member's payment profile. Validate with a dry run first, then import.
sepa_create_only_notice: Create-only: if a member already has a payment profile, the row is reported as a conflict and skipped — an existing mandate is never overwritten.

sepa_help.reference: Mandate reference (optional). Blank = a new one is generated; provided = kept.
sepa_help.paper_received_at: Date the paper mandate was received (optional).

coop_intro: Import members' existing cooperative shares (GenG equity). Each row resolves a member by member number. Validate with a dry run first, then import.
coop_unconfirmed_notice: Shares are created unconfirmed. The office confirms them through the normal flow — where the min/max equity window (GenG) is enforced for confirmed members.

coop_help.value_one: Value of a single share (currency units).
coop_help.is_increase: An increase over the mandatory amount? true/false (default false).
coop_help.due_date: Optional — payment deadline for the shares (YYYY-MM-DD).
coop_help.paid_at: Optional — the date the member actually paid (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank if still outstanding.

mode.switch_hint: For transferring existing members, cooperative shares and subscriptions from another system. Turn it off again once the transfer is done. Changing it asks for your password again.
mode.banner_intro: While onboarding mode is on, the whole tenant behaves like this:

effects.no_emails: No emails are sent except login, reseller and GDPR emails. Not sent: admission, rejection, cancellation and trial conversion emails to members, member portal invitations, waiting-list offers, and office notices about self-cancellations and failed subscription renewals. Sending a member invitation and offering a waiting-list spot are unavailable. Still sent: password resets, email verification codes, invitations and welcome emails for staff, gardener and reseller logins and for self-registration; offers, invoices (also to the accounting email), delivery notes and payment reminders to resellers; GDPR deletion emails; and test emails to your own address.
effects.confirmation_dates: The confirmation date can be set by hand.
effects.member_fields: Member number and entry date are editable in the members grid.
effects.past_start: Subscriptions may start in the past.
effects.backfill: Confirming a subscription creates deliveries back to 6 weeks in the past.
effects.departed_members: Subscriptions of members who have already left can be confirmed once the member is confirmed, if the subscription ends by the exit date.
effects.confirm_members_first: Confirm members on the members page with their confirmation date first. A member admitted instead through a subscription, an accepted invitation or, as a trial member, a new cooperative share gets today's confirmation and entry date.

mode.banner_outro: Turn the mode off again at the bottom of the page once the transfer is done.
mode.subscription_confirm_hint: Onboarding mode: if the member isn't confirmed yet, confirming this subscription admits them with today's date. Confirm the member on the members page first to enter the actual confirmation date.
mode.no_email_hint: Onboarding mode is on, so no email is sent.
mode.invitation_disabled: Onboarding mode is on, and no member invitations are sent while it is. Turn it off to invite the member.
mode.offer_spot_disabled: Onboarding mode is on, and no waiting-list offers are sent while it is. Turn it off to offer the spot.
mode.reject_warning_title: Onboarding mode is on: no rejection email is sent.
mode.reject_warning_body: The applicant is not notified. The rejection is recorded immediately and cannot be undone from this screen.

confirmation_date.label: Confirmation date
confirmation_date.hint: Onboarding mode: the date the confirmation actually happened. No email is sent.
confirmation_date.hint_departed: Onboarding mode: the member left on {{date}}. The confirmation date can't be later. Open cooperative shares are then cancelled on the exit date. No email is sent.
